files_or_snippet: dist/d3-dsv.mjs: parseRows() and its inner token() scanner (quoted-field handling, "" unescaping, CR/LF/CRLF EOL and EOF handling) and formatValue() quoting rule
how_adapted: Algorithm re-implemented (not copied verbatim) as a single-pass character state machine (parseCSV) plus formatCSV/formatValue with RFC 4180 quoting. Kept the ISC notice in src/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Retrieved with rtool npm-fetch d3-dsv@3.0.2.

NOTE: No usable existing implementation was found for the server, the query language, the sprint/burndown reporting or the SPA. Searches run: GitHub (gh-search: 'jira clone', 'kanban board issue tracker self-hosted', 'linear clone issue tracker', 'javascript search query language parser'); npm (npm-search: 'node http rest api json file store project management', 'search query parser key:value negation quoted phrases'); Stack Overflow (so-search: 'nodejs http server REST api routing without express', 'parse RFC 4180 CSV javascript quoted fields'). GitHub hits were framework apps (React/Next/Spring/Svelte) that do not match a stdlib-only node:http JSON API, and several had no license; npm and Stack Overflow yielded nothing usable. These parts were written from scratch.
